environment: Ubuntu 22.04.5 quant-server; independent running Docker Compose mw-chart-alerts-acceptance; process-local fixtures listed separately

native.scope: actual licensed chart / in-process routed synthetic fixture; no deployed instance
cases: actual widget ready
native public time scale matches eight actual bar indices
native refresh restores backend snapshot without duplicate shapes or authenticated writes
actual native mouse drag previews without writes and commits one version on release
native undo and redo submit new geometry versions while preserving monitoring lifecycle
actual native context menu prefills clicked main-series price
native log trend midpoint crosses geometric 200-price reference, not arithmetic 250
four actual native custom studies return alert-identical values including provisional last candle
actual two-chart layout retains distinct business identities and fences symbol generations
native symbol and interval round trips leave the saved alert active and unchanged
native saved-layout reload restores chart identities and one backend drawing without writes or pauses
native explicit deletion pauses once; undo restores the drawing without resuming the alert

ui.scope: actual React components / synthetic routed API, no deployed instance
cases: message subpage applies only to draft; creation defaults to one trigger
failed save and cancellation preserve draft and idempotent request; warming displayed accurately
pause/resume lifecycle; copy remains draft; event acknowledgement independent
dark/light render; modal keyboard focus and Escape cancellation

postgres_validation.scope: actual isolated PostgreSQL 17.11 migration/concurrency tests; populated full legacy migration chain

browser.scope: actual Ubuntu Docker application, native widget and authenticated parent API; real Binance source
cases: actual HTTPS login and platform native chart load
native toolbar opens real unified form; source snapshot, finite count and message persist via authenticated API
actual panel pause/resume uses persisted lifecycle; copying only opens a draft
actual native drawing geometry saves through authenticated parent and generates a new persisted version
actual mouse drag against deployed application previews without writes and commits exactly once on release
real-source linear trend and reversed log ray persist native bar-index geometry and reach ready autonomous evaluation
four actual native studies create parameter/history snapshots through authenticated parent and reach ready on real provider data
actual page refresh restores backend drawing; explicit deletion pauses the persisted rule

synthetic_api_worker.scope: running Ubuntu Compose API/worker/PostgreSQL; synthetic fixture observations
cases: running autonomous worker initializes baseline without firing
1/2/3 triggers stop at limit; sustained/equal/released same-candle observations obey counts
isolated notification sink accepts events after retry; acknowledging one leaves other events independent
price interval skips unobserved jump across range; counts only actual entries
real persisted history revision blocks indicator evaluation; explicit rebaseline preserves run/count without duplicate events

synthetic_faults.scope: deployed autonomous worker; synthetic data, gaps, stale timestamps and generated rule epoch
cases: gap fences persisted checkpoint; actual backfill yields exactly two ordered late events
container restart consumes queued bars once, preserves prior two events and completes at three
stale intrabar observation is rejected; fresh source restores ready baseline without firing

no_browser_real_source.scope: deployed API alert/provider loops and real Binance; zero live browser interests

deployed_acceptance.evidence_limits: Real-source browser verifies native/authenticated integration and ready evaluation; per-bar numeric equivalence uses actual licensed widget in controlled process-local fixture. Synthetic fault inputs stay in task-owned DB. Notification accepted is not device delivery.

backend_regression.scope: Ubuntu local Python venv; actual PostgreSQL three tests executed separately

bridge_regression.scope: native adapter public boundary; includes semantic geometry comparison, undo/redo, and coordinate snapshot fencing
